previous.context: Backdrop CMS Core 1.35.x before 1.35.2 and 1.34.x before 1.34.6 does not sufficiently validate uploaded SVG images to ensure they lack potentially dangerous SVG tags. The SVG must be viewed directly by its URL in order to run any embedded scripting.
